name: Chocolate Roulade
subtitle: Chocolate meringue rolled with cream and caramel
description: A crisp-edged chocolate meringue is filled with cream and caramel, rolled, and finished with chocolate and cocoa.

ingredients.item: cocoa powder plus extra for dusting
dark chocolate plus extra to serve
caramel sauce (from a can or jar)

instructions.text: Preheat the oven and lightly oil the tin. Line it with parchment, leaving enough overhang to help lift the roulade.
Whisk the egg whites with the lemon juice and sea salt until foamy. Gradually whisk in 225 g caster sugar until the mixture forms stiff peaks.
Fold in the cocoa powder and cornflour until evenly combined. Spread the mixture in the prepared tin and bake for 15 minutes, until set; if checked with a thermometer, the center should reach 160°F.
Let the meringue cool completely before filling.
Melt the dark chocolate with 100 ml double cream, stirring until smooth. Set aside until thickened but spreadable.
Whisk the remaining double cream with 25 g caster sugar to stiff peaks. Stir the caramel sauce until smooth.

Dust a sheet of parchment with cocoa powder and turn the cooled meringue onto it. Spread with the chocolate mixture and whipped cream, then spoon over the caramel sauce and sprinkle with sea salt flakes.
Use the parchment to roll the meringue into a roulade. Chill briefly if needed to firm the filling, then dust with cocoa powder and finish with extra chocolate and caramel sauce.
